_description: Shared conformance vectors for the scoped nullifier v1 Noir circuit and the HarpocratesRegistry Soroban contract. Both the Noir tests (nargo test) and the Rust contract tests use these same fixtures to prevent drift.
_public_input_layout_v2: 6 x BN254 field elements (192 bytes): [video_hash_hi, video_hash_lo, credential_root, nullifier, verifier_scope, epoch]
_public_input_layout_v1: 4 x BN254 field elements (128 bytes): [video_hash_hi, video_hash_lo, credential_root, nullifier]

witness.nullifier: computed by helper circuit — pedersen_hash([credential_secret, nullifier_secret, video_hash_hi, video_hash_lo, scope_hash])

scope_derivation.description: Scope field elements are derived from canonical scope strings using SHA-256 mod BN254 field modulus.

positive_cases.name: global_scope_epoch_0
positive_cases.description: Global scope (verifier_scope=0) with epoch=0. The default configuration.

positive_cases.name: explicit_scope_epoch_1
positive_cases.description: Explicit verifier scope with epoch 1. Demonstrates scoped nullifier derivation.

positive_cases.name: zero_credential_secret
positive_cases.description: Zero credential secret is a valid BN254 field element. Edge case.

positive_cases.name: max_field_credential_secret
positive_cases.description: Maximum BN254 field value (prime - 1) as credential secret. Edge case.

positive_cases.name: zero_video_hash
positive_cases.description: All-zero video hash (blank-frame video). Edge case with correct secrets.

positive_cases.name: cross_scope_different_nullifiers
positive_cases.description: Same credential and video, different scopes produce different nullifiers. Demonstrates scope binding.
positive_cases.expected: pass — both scopes produce distinct nullifiers

positive_cases.name: epoch_rotation_valid
positive_cases.description: After epoch rotation, a new proof with the updated epoch is accepted.
positive_cases.expected: pass — epoch 1 proof accepted after rotation

negative_cases.name: wrong_credential_secret
negative_cases.description: Wrong credential secret in the witness — credential root assertion fails.

negative_cases.name: wrong_nullifier_secret
negative_cases.description: Wrong nullifier secret in the witness — nullifier assertion fails.

negative_cases.name: wrong_video_hash_hi
negative_cases.description: Wrong video_hash_hi in public inputs — nullifier assertion fails.

negative_cases.name: wrong_video_hash_lo
negative_cases.description: Wrong video_hash_lo in public inputs — nullifier assertion fails.

negative_cases.name: nullifier_from_different_scope
negative_cases.description: Nullifier computed for scope=999 must not satisfy scope=0. Proves scope binding.

negative_cases.name: nullifier_from_different_epoch
negative_cases.description: Nullifier computed for epoch=2 must not satisfy epoch=1. Proves epoch binding.

negative_cases.name: nullifier_from_different_video
negative_cases.description: Nullifier computed for a different video must not satisfy the current video hash.

negative_cases.name: tampered_scope_public_input
negative_cases.description: Correct nullifier for scope=0, but scope public input is tampered to 1.

negative_cases.name: tampered_epoch_public_input
negative_cases.description: Correct nullifier for epoch=1, but epoch public input is tampered to 0.

negative_cases.name: swapped_credential_root_and_nullifier
negative_cases.description: Credential root and nullifier positions are swapped in public inputs.

negative_cases.name: stale_epoch_rejected
negative_cases.description: Proof with epoch 0 is rejected when the current scope epoch is 1.

negative_cases.name: future_epoch_rejected
negative_cases.description: Proof with epoch 2 is rejected when the current scope epoch is 1.

v1_v2_compatibility.description: v1 (128-byte) and v2 (192-byte) proofs use different derivation formulas and produce different nullifiers for the same credential and video.
v1_v2_compatibility.nullifier_independence: v1 and v2 nullifiers for the same credential/video are different values because the derivation formulas differ (v1 does not include scope_hash).

test_case.name: v1_v2_nullifiers_are_different
test_case.video_hash: same for both v1 and v2
test_case.expected: both v1 and v2 proofs succeed with distinct nullifiers
